title: KIP Spring 2027 - Trustee & Government Affairs Intern - The American Council of Trustees and Alumni
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

The American Council of Trustees and Alumni (ACTA) seeks a motivated Spring 2027 Intern for the Trustee & Government Affairs (TGA) department. The TGA Intern supports ACTA’s mission to advance academic excellence, academic freedom, and accountability across higher education. Working directly with the Director of External Affairs, the intern plays an active role in maintaining national networks of university trustees and elected officials while executing targeted communication strategies.
This role is Washington, DC based, and applicants must be able to reliably commute to the ACTA office. Hybrid arrangements may be considered for exceptional candidates.
To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: Commercial Associate

We’re looking for ambitious people that want to be part of our meaningful vision of changing how businesses engage with their customers, and of building one of the world’s leading workplaces for great people along the way.

The Role:

We're looking for people who are either:

- Serious about building a career in sales.

- Or coming from a different field and making a deliberate move into sales.

Ultimately, we want someone who wants to progress quickly to be an Account Executive within 12 months.

What makes this opportunity unique is that you're not just learning how to generate leads. You'll be trained across the entire sales process, from prospecting and discovery through to running demos, building business cases, and closing deals. You'll learn directly from our top sellers, work alongside experienced Account Executives on live opportunities, and gradually take on more commercial responsibility as you develop.

At Hook, we believe great salespeople are made through a combination of ambition, curiosity, ownership, and exceptional coaching. That's why we've built a structured 12-month programme with a clear progression path to Account Executive, giving you the opportunity to go from learning the fundamentals to owning your own revenue target and doubling your earning potential.

This isn't a stop-gap job. It's a genuine opportunity to fast-track your career in one of the most rewarding professions out there. If you're hungry to learn, motivated to earn, and ready to push yourself to become exceptional at what you do, we'd love to speak to you.

If you're hungry to learn, motivated to earn, and want to fast-track your career in sales, this is for you.

Find out more about what it's like to be part of the Sales team at Hook: https://workinsales.hook.co/ https://workinsales.hook.co/

🔨 WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO

- Learn how to sell: Go through an intensive sales bootcamp covering messaging, discovery, demos, negotiation, and closing.

- Build pipeline: Identify opportunities, engage senior decision-makers, and learn how to turn conversations into qualified deals.

- Master the sales process: Shadow Account Executives, join live customer calls, practise demos, and learn how to build compelling business cases.

- Win new business: As you progress, own a qualified deals target, run discovery calls and demos, and work alongside AEs to close opportunities.

- Own a revenue line: Once you're ready, step up to a full revenue target, manage your own deals from start to finish, and unlock double the earning potential.

- Level up fast: Get hands-on coaching, regular feedback, and a clear roadmap to becoming an Account Executive.

🙌 WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- You're seriously ambitious: You have a real hunger to succeed, progress quickly, and achieve big personal and financial goals.

- You take ownership: You hold yourself accountable, own your mistakes, and focus on what you can do better rather than making excuses.

- You're a self-starter: You don't need someone telling you what to do. You take initiative, figure things out, and make things happen.

- You're curious: You genuinely want to understand how businesses work, what drives buying decisions, and what makes great salespeople successful.

- You're highly coachable: You actively seek feedback, take it on board without ego, and put it into practice quickly.

The client work is varied, from fast-turnaround BAU creative responses to in-person creative sprints and full campaign productions across global markets, and generative AI now runs through most of it.

On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. title: Mechanical Engineer, PCBA Test Infrastructure, Robotics
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer for a senior individual-contributor role leading printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) test fixtures and infrastructure for advanced robotic systems. You will independently turn evolving requirements into working fixtures, make technical tradeoffs, and own delivery from concept and detailed design through fabrication, validation, deployment, and reliable operation.

This role combines development-lab work with deployment at contract manufacturers. You will build precision mechanical systems for board programming, functional test, and characterization, including board nests, probe plates, connector interfaces, alignment features, clamps, enclosures, and thermal interfaces. You will partner with electrical, firmware, software, manufacturing, and reliability teams to make fixtures repeatable, protective of delicate assemblies, and maintainable as board designs evolve.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. Travel to contract-manufacturer sites is part of the role, with timing based on build and deployment needs.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own the mechanical architecture of PCBA test stations, including frames, board nests, datum schemes, access, guarding, ergonomics, and serviceability.

- Design probe and bed-of-nails fixtures, connector-mating mechanisms, board supports, clamps, and interchangeable tooling for programming, functional test, and characterization.

- Use first-principles analysis and simulation to assess stiffness, probe and insertion forces, board deflection, tolerance stacks, thermal growth, and fixture life; validate key predictions on hardware.

- Develop locating and compliance features that accommodate board and assembly variation, protect components and solder joints, and preserve contact repeatability across loading cycles and board revisions.

- Partner with electrical engineers on test-point access, probe selection, connector engagement, ESD provisions, cable routing, cooling, and interlocks; define motion and sequencing constraints with software and controls partners.

- Design safe loading, pinch-point protection, hard stops, and operator access for manual or actuated fixtures. Make wear components easy to inspect, clean, and replace.

- Manage fabrication partners and component vendors. Release CAD, drawings, bills of materials, tolerance analyses, assembly instructions, inspection plans, and maintenance procedures.

- Own fixture deployment and acceptance at contract manufacturers, including assembly and alignment checks, correlation with lab fixtures, operator training, and troubleshooting. Support replication, board-revision changes, and maintenance through released documentation.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have strong mechanical intuition for precision interfaces, load paths, compliance, tolerances, and the behavior of delicate electronic assemblies.

- Move readily between analysis, CAD, vendor collaboration, and hands-on assembly and debugging.

- Care about repeatable contact, controlled forces, operator usability, and equipment that others can maintain.

- Take ownership from concept through reliable daily operation, adapting fixtures to evolving boards and communicating clearly across electrical, software, manufacturing, and operations team

title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Search Integrity
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Foundations Research team works on high-risk, high-reward ideas that could shape the next decade of AI. Our goal is to advance the science and data that enable our training and scaling efforts, with a particular focus on future frontier models. We push the boundaries of data, scaling laws, optimization techniques, model architectures, model + search co-design and efficiency improvements to propel our science.

The Search team sits within Foundations, building agentic search by co-designing model-system interfaces with the core search stack: serving, indexing, and retrieval. We research and develop large-scale systems that transform and index vast corpora, enabling models to most effectively find and reason over information. In close partnership with researchers, we bring modeling advances into production and improve how AI systems discover, retrieve, and use knowledge.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Researcher to lead Search Integrity: the systems that distinguish useful web content from spam, manipulation, and other adversarial or low-quality material.

The challenge extends beyond evaluating individual pages. A page may appear credible in isolation, while its links, metadata, or relationships with other sites reveal coordinated manipulation. As AI makes convincing content easier to produce at scale, detection systems must adapt to increasingly sophisticated adversaries.

You’ll define the technical approach, build classifiers and evaluations, and shape how integrity signals influence what Search indexes and retrieves. Working closely with Search and broader Safety and Integrity teams, you’ll use frontier models to advance detection methods and bring them into production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define the technical direction for Search Integrity, identifying gaps and determining which problems and interventions to prioritize.

- Develop AI and ML systems to detect spam, scams, phishing, malicious domains, prompt injections, and other adversarial or low-quality web content.

- Discover useful signals across page content, links, domains, metadata, and relationships between websites, including patterns that reveal coordinated manipulation.

- Build evaluations that measure detection quality and how integrity interventions affect the information Search surfaces.

- Translate detection signals into indexing, ranking, and filtering decisions, improving what models can retrieve and rely on.

- Serve as the technical owner for integrity within Search, partnering with researchers, engineers, and broader Safety and Integrity teams to build and deploy these systems.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

- Deep experience in web spam, search quality, adversarial content detection, or related integrity problems at scale.

- Strong applied ML and research skills, with experience developing classifiers, detection methods, and evaluations for real-world systems.

- An understanding of how adversaries manipulate content and links, coordinate across sites, and adapt to detection systems.

- A track record of independently defining ambiguous technical problems and driving solutions from experimentation through production.

- Experience working across research, engineering, and integrity teams while remaining hands-on with technical work.

- A first-principles approach to using frontier models and compute, and a strong interest in keeping detection systems effective as adversaries evolve.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

You will join the Hybrid Platform Engineering track, which builds and operates the compute layer underpinning DeepL's products and research: the Kubernetes control plane, node lifecycle, networking, storage and core cluster services, across both on-prem and cloud infrastructure. title: Accounting Manager — AI & Automation
description:
Are you an accounting leader who is obsessed with AI?
We're looking for an experienced accountant who believes AI is going to fundamentally change how accounting gets done - and wants to be at the forefront of that transformation. Arboreal manages more than 10,000 apartments, and we've built our own property-management software platform, Maynard, with extensive APIs and MCP tools that let AI agents work directly in our accounting systems. This role is your chance to prove how much more a great accountant can accomplish when the manual work is handed to AI and the judgment stays with you.
The Role
This is a new kind of accounting role, built for how Arboreal intends to run its accounting function going forward. Rather than managing a team of people, the Accounting Manager oversees the accounting for a book of work primarily through AI agents operating on Maynard in conjunction with AppFolio. The focus is judgment and review: directing and supervising automated workflows, tackling complex reconciliations and investigations with AI, preparing and reviewing journal entries, validating what the agents produce, and standing behind the accuracy of the financials. You'll be one of four Accounting Managers who work side by side to make sure financials go out on time and accurately and that balances are reconciled across the portfolio. A shared pool of accountants performs a limited set of manual tasks and AI-assisted supporting reconciliations; these accountants do not report to this role. You'll have direct access to the CFO, the engineering team, and our AI-enabled accounting tools - and you'll be encouraged to experiment, improve processes, and figure out how much more is possible. This position reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer and spans accounts payable and receivable, corporate accounting, client onboarding and offboarding, and the review of property financials.
Oversee Accounting Through AI Agents & Automation

• Own the accounting for an assigned book of work, executed primarily through AI agents running on Maynard alongside AppFolio - directing, supervising, and quality-controlling their output rather than performing each task by hand.

• Use AI to tackle complex reconciliations, investigate accounting problems, and automate work that traditionally takes hours of manual effort.

• Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations, and review AI- and system-generated entries and reports for accuracy, completeness, proper coding, and compliance with U.S. GAAP before they are relied upon.

• Identify, investigate, and resolve exceptions the agents flag or that review surfaces, and determine when a human needs to step in.

• Experiment with and improve agent workflows, prompts, rules, and controls - partnering with the CFO and engineering team so the system produces reliable results and keeps getting better.

• Act as a knowledgeable check on automation - understanding what the agents are doing well enough to catch when an output is wrong, and never signing off on numbers that have not been verified.

Timely & Accurate Financial Reporting

• Work alongside the other three Accounting Managers to ensure financial statements go out on time and accurately for the assigned portfolio each period.

• Coordinate the close calendar and hand-offs across the manager group so there are no gaps or duplicated work, and so dependencies are met.

• Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close and produce financials in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Provide the CFO with variance explanations, supporting schedules, and management reporting for lenders, owners, and external tax preparers and auditors.

Reconciliations & Balance Integrity

• Ensure balance-sheet accounts are reconciled and that balances are supported, reviewing the AI-assisted reconciliations prepared on the platform and by the accountant pool.

You'll join our five-person Moderation team, which builds the product customers use to detect, review and act on harmful content in their apps. The role leans backend. - A track record of shipping features used at scale and of refactoring and improving existing production systems.

- Working knowledge of React and TypeScript or JavaScript.

- Experience with automated testing across client and server code.

- Comfort working with customers and handling production incidents.

title: SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Germany
Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.
The programme
A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.
You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.
What you will work on
Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.
What you bring
8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.
Useful but not essential:
SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung unserer Coaching-Programme. title: Senior Consultant - Cyber Security
description:
At Electric Mind, Engineering is where strategy meets action. Our team helps organizations cut through complexity-aligning business ambition with technology execution to unlock real, lasting change. You’ll work alongside curious, driven people tackling high-impact challenges for everyone from scaling startups to global enterprises. Each engagement is different, pushing you to learn, adapt, and grow.  

Electric Mind’s Technology Practice brings together deep engineering expertise, modern delivery disciplines, and pragmatic architectural thinking to help clients execute complex, mission-critical transformation. We design and implement scalable, secure, high-impact technology solutions that accelerate business outcomes.  

About the Role
 
We advise large U.S. banks, broker-dealers, and insurers on the most consequential 
cyber security problems they face - the ones that show up in MRAs, MRIAs, Consent Orders.
 
As a Senior Consultant on our Cyber & Regulatory Remediation team, you will lead client-facing workstreams that translate regulator findings into defensible, executable remediation plans, and then drive those plans to closure alongside CISO, Risk, and Audit leadership.
 
This is not a generic GRC role. You will own the substance: writing remediation roadmaps that an OCC, FRB, or NY DFS examiner will accept, hardening the controls that fail under exam, and personally pushing technical workstreams - incident response, vulnerability and patch management, and identity - across the finish line.

About Electric Mind 

Electric Mind is a fast-growing, AI-native advisory and digital engineering firm built for those who want to shape the future, not just watch it happen. We blend premium strategy expertise with cutting-edge AI-centric engineering to solve complex, meaningful problems for industry-leading clients.  

We pride ourselves on a high-touch delivery model and a culture that values diverse talent, innovation, and true client partnership - creating an environment where your ideas matter and your impact is visible.  
If you’re looking for a place where you can grow fast, collaborate with exceptional teammates, and help build a company scaling its capabilities and global footprint at speed - Electric Mind is the place to ignite your career. The future is bright! 

For more info on Electric Mind, check out our Careers Page and Instagram.

Electric Mind is committed to diversity in the workplace. We are an inclusive employer and welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates. Applicants’ needs will be accommodated during our recruitment and selection process so please advise us if you require accommodation.

title: Account Executive, Enterprise (Berlin, Germany)

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

We are looking for a strategic and ambitious Senior Bids Manager to lead our most complex, high-value opportunities across the public and private sectors. At Faculty, we are transforming how organisations operate using AI, and you will be at the heart of this mission.

You will orchestrate end-to-end bid processes, distilling technical brilliance into persuasive, customer-centric proposals. As a core role within our Central Sales function, you will drive revenue growth and refine the frameworks that empower Faculty to win and scale our global impact.

- Facilitating milestone meetings and managing client interactions to ensure clarity, alignment, and high-quality outcomes throughout the delivery phase.

- You bring advanced experience in managing large-scale, complex bids within the private or public sectors, backed by a proven track record of success.

- You possess exceptional communication skills, with a flair for translating sophisticated AI concepts into clear, actionable, and persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.

- You are a natural relationship-builder, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders to extract high-quality insights under tight deadlines.

- You exhibit a highly organised and proactive mindset, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can navigate multiple priorities with scientific rigour.

- You lead with integrity and a collaborative spirit, enjoying the process of guiding team members and contributing to a high-performing, inclusive culture.

title: Advanced Services Manager, EMEA
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Everpure is seeking an experienced manager to lead part of our fast-growing Advanced Services organization across EMEA and LATAM. In this role you will build, lead, and manage a team of Architects who scope and deliver complex, high-value projects with partners and for customers throughout the region. You will recruit, motivate, and mentor your team to deliver a consistently high-quality customer experience.

You will partner with customers, Customer Experience, Sales, Systems Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering to design highly-scalable, resilient data management solutions that deliver the outcomes our customers need. You think strategically about business problems, products, and technical challenges, and you thrive on connecting technology to measurable business value. Most importantly, leading a team to collaborate, excel, and keep improving energizes you. This role reports to the Director, Advanced Services (EMEA/LATAM), and is ideal for a manager ready to take the next step in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, multi-country environment.

What You Will Be Doing

You will work on cross-functional teams including Sales, Product Management, Services, and Engineering to architect and deliver Advanced Services solutions across a multi-country, multi-language region. You will become intimately acquainted with each customer's and partner's business requirements, technical needs, systems, environment, and service history, enabling you to present targeted, value-added solutions. This leadership role spans pre-sales and delivery functions, and you will be comfortable performing both while guiding your team to excel.

• Manage the Architecture delivery team across EMEA/LATAM in accordance with established standards and guidelines.

• Develop and cultivate highly collaborative, productive relationships with Sales, Sales Engineers, Product Management, Engineering, and other cross-functional leaders across the region to enable sales and drive Everpure's success.

• Participate in pre-sales engagements with customers, presenting Advanced Services capabilities with compelling, enterprise-ready value propositions.

• Oversee technical design architects to ensure customer satisfaction across all assigned accounts and projects in EMEA and LATAM.

• Provide continuous feedback to direct reports through regular coaching, employee development, and annual performance reviews.

• Lead, support, and implement Advanced Services, Customer Experience, and Everpure corporate initiatives across the region.

• Manage escalations resulting from CSAT issues, including across multiple time zones and languages.

• Provide feedback on the services portfolio to help engineer and pioneer new services, informed by regional market needs.

What You'll Need to Bring to This Role

• Strong leadership capabilities and experience across all aspects of Advanced Services, with a demonstrated track record of growing a high-quality, multi-country organization.

• Strategic knowledge of the services sales process and creative business acumen.

• High degree of competency developing, leading, and inspiring services-focused teams to overachieve goals.

• Well versed on the strengths and weaknesses of key competitors in the data storage industry, and how to turn that knowledge into competitive advantage.

• Working knowledge of customer expectations for large Enterprise and Global accounts, including across diverse EMEA

title: Senior Medical Officer (NZ)
description:
• Make the most of your significant medical experience in this key aviation role

• Bring your pragmatic, flexible, problem solving and adaptable approach

• Relationship and stakeholder management to influence at a senior level

About the role
We have a great opportunity for a NZ registered medical practitioner, or a candidate who can easily obtain NZ medical registration, coupled with the desire to move into a new and exciting regulatory environment.
You’ll be working with a dynamic team responsible for the setting, maintaining and monitoring of medical standards, practices and procedures within the aviation industry. This role offers the opportunity to review complex cases, complete research, and collaborate with medical examiners and aviation industry partners to provide best advice and information. There will also be opportunities to lead a diverse range of change projects and improvement initiatives.
The salary band for a Senior Medical Officer goes from $188,168 to $261,778 with the mid-range being $230,231. Starting salaries will be based on knowledge, skills and experience the successful candidate brings to the role, and relativities both, within the immediate team and in the broader Authority for the same or similar roles.
For more information on the role please view the position description.
What You’ll Bring
We are interested in hearing from experienced practitioners who are excellent communicators with an empathetic, open, and diplomatic style. There are exciting changes on the horizon both legislatively and operationally which brings with it innovation and improvement.
To be successful in this role you will,

• Hold current registration to practice medicine in New Zealand

• Ideally hold a Diploma or Masters in Aviation Medicine (or equivalent). If not, you will be willing to undertake appropriate training and have a strong bent towards General Practise, Occupational Medicine or Emergency Medicine

• Be a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment

• Effective relationships and stakeholder management skills

• Excellent problem-solving skills and confident decision-making capabilities

• A pragmatic, flexible and adaptable approach

• Offer a range of aviation medicine experience - from those willing to commit to the Fellowship Training Programme of the Australasian College of Aerospace Medicine or to senior highly experienced specialists

Whist the position is ideally based in Wellington, we are flexible to look at remote working within NZ which will involve travel, as well as flexible hours if you wish to retain one day per week clinical practice.
About us
The Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) is New Zealand’s aviation safety and security regulator. We play a critical role in protecting the travelling public, supporting the aviation sector, and strengthening New Zealand’s international reputation.
Our vision is simple and powerful: A safe and secure aviation system - so people are safe, and feel safe when they fly.
Our values: Professionalism, Respect, Integrity, Transparency, and Collaboration guide everything we do. We’re committed to diversity, inclusion, and creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to contribute.
Why Join Us?

title: Applied AI Course Author
description:

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners (people with no prior tech background) through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
We’re looking for an experienced Course Author in Applied AI to help design and develop a graduate-level online program in Applied Artificial Intelligence, delivered in partnership with a US university. The program is built for working professionals in fields such as marketing, operations, finance and HR. They learn to evaluate, build, integrate, deploy and govern AI solutions using modern no-code and low-code tools. You’ll turn approved course syllabi into engaging, rigorous learning materials and help shape how a new generation of AI practitioners learns to make sound, defensible decisions.
This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for subject matter experts who are passionate about teaching, curriculum design and helping learners succeed.
Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.
After applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.

title: Washington Rural Healthcare CFO Opportunities

Washington Rural Healthcare CFO Opportunities
Rural Staffing Services partners with rural hospitals, clinics, public hospital districts, and community healthcare organizations throughout Washington to identify experienced financial leaders who understand the unique responsibilities of rural healthcare.
We are currently connecting with healthcare finance executives who may be interested in active and upcoming Chief Financial Officer and senior financial leadership opportunities across Washington .
These opportunities may include leadership within Critical Access Hospitals, rural and community hospitals, Rural Health Clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers, public hospital districts, long-term care organizations, and integrated rural healthcare systems.
This Is More Than a CFO Role
In rural healthcare, the Chief Financial Officer is not simply responsible for financial reports and budgets. The CFO helps protect the long-term stability of an organization that may be one of the most essential employers and community resources in the region.
Rural healthcare finance requires strong technical knowledge, sound judgment, adaptability, and the ability to communicate clearly with executive leaders, department managers, boards, employees, and community partners.
The strongest rural CFOs understand that every financial decision connects directly to patient access, workforce stability, community trust, and the organization's ability to continue serving its region.
What You May Lead
Responsibilities will vary by organization and may include:

• Providing strategic and operational leadership for the organization's financial functions

• Developing budgets, forecasts, financial plans, and long-term sustainability strategies

• Overseeing accounting, financial reporting, cash flow, audits, and internal controls

• Supporting revenue cycle performance and reimbursement strategy

• Monitoring financial performance and communicating results to executive leadership and the governing board

• Managing relationships with auditors, banks, vendors, government agencies, and external partners

• Supporting capital planning, grants, funding initiatives, and major organizational projects

• Partnering with operational and clinical leaders to improve performance and resource stewardship

• Ensuring compliance with applicable financial, regulatory, and reporting requirements

• Helping the organization navigate growth, transition, turnaround, or financial uncertainty

What You Will Bring
Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

• Progressive healthcare finance leadership experience

• Experience as a CFO, Vice President of Finance, Controller, Finance Director, or comparable senior leader

• Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, accounting, audits, reimbursement, and financial reporting

• Experience presenting financial information to boards and executive teams

• An understanding of rural healthcare operations and reimbursement

• Experience with Critical Access Hospitals, public hospital districts, FQHCs, Rural Health Clinics, or community healthcare organizations

• A bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, healthcare administration, or a related field

• A master's degree, CPA, or other advanced credential may be preferred for some opportunities

• A collaborative, transparent, and relationship-focused leadership style

Why Rural Washington?
Washington's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, forests, farmland, rivers, islands, and coastlines. These organizations often operate with limited resources while carrying an enormous responsibility to the people they serve.
Financial leadership in a rural setting offers the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work, build meaningful relationships, and help protect healthcare access for an entire community.

title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Residential Appraisals for Mortgage Lenders
description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Comparois an AI-native residential appraisal firm built for independent mortgage banks and private lenders. Today, a lender waits 5 to 10 days for an appraisal that takes under an hour of real analytical work. Comparo collapses that to 24 hours. Homeowners or data collectors capture the property with a phone scan, AI selects comparables, runs adjustments and drafts the full report, and a licensed appraiser reviews and signs. Comparo sells the finished, UAD 3.6-compliant appraisal rather than software, so it owns the workflow end to end and captures the full per-report fee. The same engine extends to tax appeals, insurance, estate valuations and continuous portfolio revaluation for lenders and mortgage-backed asset holders.
Market Context
The US residential appraisal industry is an $8.8-11.4B market, with roughly 5 million appraisals completed each year at $400-700 per report. Mortgage appraisals ordered by independent mortgage banks and private lenders represent a $1.5-2.1B serviceable market. The timing is sharp: UAD 3.6 becomes mandatory on November 2, 2026, expanding each report from roughly 700 to 3,600 data fields, while an aging workforce of 75,000-80,000 licensed appraisers shrinks.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

• Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

• Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

• Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

• Investor and advisor network across fintech, proptech and early-stage capital markets

• A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight ’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

• Strategy - Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

• Customer Development - Lead pilots with independent mortgage banks and private lenders, convert them to paid engagements, secure approved-panel status, and build the go-to-market motion

• Product - Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

• Capital - Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight 's network and traction

• Team - Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

• Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

• Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

• Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

• Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

• Direct exposure to mortgage lending, residential appraisal, AMC operations, or proptech

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
description:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) marwa.hamdi@mines-albi.fr
en collaboration avec Safa Layeb Safa.layeb@mines-albi.fr et Franck Fontanili Franck.fontanili@mines-albi.fr

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

• Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama nel.samama@telecom-sudparis.eu

• Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet marius.huguet@emse.fr

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):
Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning
Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :
L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.
Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.
Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.
Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.
Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.
Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?
Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S - CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage
L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

• Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

• Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. You'll join a small, fast-moving team building Chainguard Harness.

Chainguard Harness uses frontier AI models to hunt down exploitable vulnerabilities in a customer's application, then delivers validated findings with recommended fixes, with no model access required. Customers trust us with their source code, so security isn't just a feature of this product. It is the product.

As a Staff engineer you'll own large parts of the Harness architecture, guide technical decisions across the team, and help take the product from beta to a service that scales to many more customers and environments.

What you'll do

•
Own major parts of the system end to end, from design through implementation, rollout, and operation

•
Build security into the foundation: protecting customer code end to end, least-privilege access, and auditing everything the system and its operators do. Partner with Product and Security on threat models and reviews.

•
Make Harness a reliable, observable, production-grade service, making sound long-term tradeoffs around scale, cost, technical debt, and build versus buy.

•
Work directly with customers, Product, and our field team. You'll join customer calls and turn feedback into the roadmap.

•
Raise the bar for the team through design docs, code review, and mentoring, and by showing how AI tooling can make a small team move fast without cutting corners on security.

What we're looking for

•
10+ years of experience in software development

•
A track record of building and operating production services where security and data confidentiality were hard requirements, not afterthoughts

•
Experience designing systems that hold confidential customer data end to end

•
Experience shipping software into air-gapped, disconnected, or highly restricted environments

•
Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on GCP and/or AWS, including IAM, KMS, networking, and infrastructure as code (Terraform)

•
Hands-on experience with virtualization and workload isolation, such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker or Cloud Hypervisor, gVisor, nested virtualization, or bare-metal hosts

•
A working knowledge of applied cryptography: envelope encryption, key management and rotation, HSM/KMS-backed keys, and signing

•
Proficiency with Go

•
Experience with AI tooling and a genuine enthusiasm for applying it to hard problems; experience building agentic systems is a plus

•
Strong communication skills and proficiency in English. You can explain a security model to an engineer, a security reviewer, and a customer's CISO, and you work autonomously, take initiative, and ask for help early.

Nice to have

•
A background in offensive security, vulnerability research, penetration testing, or application security, and a sense of what separates a real, exploitable finding from noise

•
Experience building and running arbitrary third-party code across many languages and build systems

•
Familiarity with vulnerability data and disclosure: CVE and OSV formats, triage and deduplication, and coordinated disclosure

•
Experience distributing self-hosted software: Kubernetes and Helm, signed artifacts, SBOMs, and supply-chain provenance

•
Experience with GitHub or GitLa
